claims.text: The Random Kitchen Sink (RKS) approach explicitly maps data vectors to a space where linear separation is possible, facilitating classification tasks.
RKS has been effectively used for offensive language detection in social media, achieving high accuracy when applied to features from models like Fasttext.
The RKS method provides an approximate kernel function via explicit mapping, improving the performance of classification algorithms.
